items.title: Write the Koala-to-Lattice role naming execution document
items.context: Capture inventory, canonical rename map, compatibility boundary, affected template/runtime/doc/test surfaces, and verification commands before changing the role IDs.
items.userSees: The user can open docs/requirements/decisions/koala-to-lattice-role-naming-execution-plan.md and see the inventory, rename map, boundary, rollout steps, and verification commands for the Koala-to-Lattice role migration.

happy.desc: Execution document lists every canonical active koala-* role ID and its lattice-* replacement.

edge.desc: Document distinguishes active role IDs from legacy runtime/archive compatibility strings such as KOALA_* or .koala references.

adversarial.desc: Document does not claim all Koala tokens are gone when intentionally preserved historical/runtime compatibility references remain.

items.title: Rename canonical agent templates and mirrored host assets from koala-* to lattice-*
items.context: Template filenames, frontmatter names, prompt prose, .claude agent assets, and .Codex agent assets must share the same Lattice role IDs so regenerated assets do not reintroduce Koala names.
items.userSees: Terminal search prints no active Koala agent filenames: `find packages/main/templates/agents .claude/agents .Codex/agents -maxdepth 1 -type f | rg koala-` exits with no matches.

happy.desc: Canonical template files and mirrored .claude/.Codex assets use lattice-* filenames and frontmatter names.

edge.desc: Product-reviewer, implementation-reviewer, test-intent, and test-case-reviewer assets remain correctly named and are not accidentally converted.

adversarial.desc: A search of active template and mirrored agent directories does not find koala-* role IDs after the rename.

items.title: Update CLI runtime role dispatch, schemas, attribution, and help text to Lattice naming
items.context: story_dispatch defaults, reviewer requirement maps, command schemas, commit author fallback, review/pass/finding guidance, and visible help text must stop emitting koala-* identifiers. Legacy koala role aliases should be deleted unless needed only for read-only historical metadata.
items.userSees: Lattice CLI help and workflow hints refer to lattice-implementer and lattice-review-* role IDs, and review/finding/runtime checks accept the lattice reviewer prefix as canonical.

happy.desc: CLI schemas, defaults, help text, dispatch prompts, and review attribution use lattice-* role IDs.

edge.desc: Historical metadata compatibility remains readable only where explicitly documented, without reintroducing active koala-* aliases.

adversarial.desc: review_run_start/finding_add/review_pass_set reject stale koala-review-* active role usage once lattice-* is canonical.

items.title: Update documentation, audits, and tests so active surfaces no longer teach Koala naming
items.context: Active docs should teach lattice-* role IDs; legacy archived docs can remain only when explicitly marked historical. Tests and verifier snapshots should assert the Lattice naming surface.
items.userSees: Active documentation and tests teach Lattice role IDs; any remaining Koala references are explicitly historical, runtime-compatibility, or archive material rather than current role guidance.

happy.desc: Active docs and tests that mention agent role IDs use lattice-* names.

edge.desc: Archived Koala docs under legacy paths are not rewritten unless needed to label them as historical.

adversarial.desc: Docs do not instruct users to invoke koala-implementer or koala-review-* for new Lattice work.

items.title: Verify no active CLI/template/runtime surface still emits Koala role IDs
items.context: Run targeted rg inventory, CLI help/version checks, unit/build tests, and Codex adapter verification if host agent assets changed.
items.userSees: Verification output shows build/test/Codex adapter checks passing and targeted rg scans show no active koala-* role IDs in CLI help, templates, mirrored host assets, or active documentation.

happy.desc: npm build/test and node bin/lattice.js verify_codex pass after the rename.

edge.desc: Targeted rg scans separate active role IDs from permitted historical/runtime compatibility references.

adversarial.desc: lattice help and dispatch-related help do not emit koala-* role guidance after rebuild.

auditLog.reason: Start agent template and mirrored asset rename.
Start runtime role dispatch/schema/gate naming migration.
